incidents.name: GymSinglePool depositFromOtherContract missing access control
incidents.notes: GymSinglePool.depositFromOtherContract() had no caller authorization, so anyone could book an arbitrary deposit amount for themselves without transferring any tokens and then withdraw the GYMNET the fake position had accrued.

sources.ref: onchain review: pool proxy 0xa8987285e100a8b557f06a7889f79e0064b359f2 created 2022-05-15 by 0xc08d6d75fdd67005fa21933bd281b1e6180184b2 (GYM deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0xb2c035eee03b821cbe78644e5da8b8eaa711d2e5; attack tx located from the pool's own logs at BSC block 18501050; 8 EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2022-06-05 to implementation 0x0288fba0bf19072d30490a0f3c81cd9b0634258a - the upgrade that shipped the unprotected function, 2.4 days before the incident; the team's fix added an onlyBank modifier

incidents.name: Gym Network LiquidityMigrationV2 migrate() flaw
incidents.notes: LiquidityMigrationV2.migrate() converted GYM/WBNB LP into GYMNET/WBNB LP without validating the incoming LP's composition, so a flash loan minted LP against a skewed GYM pair and migrated it out for far more GYMNET-backed liquidity than it was worth.

sources.ref: onchain review: LiquidityMigrationV2 0x1BEfe6f3f0E8edd2D4D15Cae97BAEe01E51ea4A4 created 2022-03-24T11:10:59Z by 0x86dfe4dd65c962cfce0ed5b60fcf90840b26f7c2, unrelated to attack sender 0x74298086c94dab3252c5dac979c9755c2eb08e49; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attack sender netted 1,327.14 WBNB in the exploit transaction. Loss converted: 1,327.14 WBNB x $423.16 at incidentTimestamp 1649518714 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $561,595.
